strings.zh: 从建筑艺术角度来讲,{NEWLINE}阿鲁夫遗迹的石室{CLEAR}跟周围桔梗市、缘朱市的{CLEAR}古建筑风格截然不同,{CLEAR}完全不像是同一种文明的造物。{SCROLL}反而是我在水都群岛看到的{NEWLINE}一座祭祀神庙,{CLEAR}跟阿鲁夫遗迹的建筑风格如出一辙。{SCROLL}这是不是意味着水都的神庙{NEWLINE}和阿鲁夫遗迹有着某种联系呢？
strings.en: Architecturally, the chambers of{NEWLINE}the Ruins of Alph are nothing like the{CLEAR}old buildings of nearby Violet City and{CLEAR}Ecruteak City. They don’t look like the{CLEAR}work of the same civilization at all.{SCROLL}Instead, a ritual temple I saw in the{NEWLINE}Alto Mare Islands is built in exactly{CLEAR}the same style as the Ruins of Alph.{SCROLL}Could that mean the temple in{NEWLINE}Alto Mare is somehow connected{CLEAR}to the Ruins of Alph?

strings.zh: 呼……这下子轻松多了,{NEWLINE}谢谢你的伤药。{SCROLL}其实我是在阿鲁夫遗迹下面参观时,{NEWLINE}突然发现一座石像上{CLEAR}出现了我自己的脸。{CLEAR}因为害怕,我就慌忙地往外跑,{CLEAR}结果在跑的时候跌倒受伤了。{SCROLL}我非常想知道{NEWLINE}为什么石像上会出现我的脸,{CLEAR}但是又不敢回去看,{CLEAR}能请你帮我去看看为什么会这样吗？
strings.en: Phew... That’s much better.{NEWLINE}Thanks for the Potion.{SCROLL}The truth is, I was looking{NEWLINE}around under the Ruins of Alph{CLEAR}when suddenly my own face{CLEAR}appeared on a stone statue.{SCROLL}I got scared and ran for the exit, and{NEWLINE}I tripped and hurt myself on the way.{SCROLL}I really want to know why my{NEWLINE}face was on that statue, but I’m{CLEAR}too scared to go back and look.{CLEAR}Could you go and find out for me?

strings.zh: 你查到遗迹里出现我的脸的原因了？{NEWLINE}快告诉我是为什么！

strings.en: Oh, so there was a Bronzor{NEWLINE}on the statue, and the face I saw{CLEAR}was my reflection on the Bronzor!{SCROLL}Thanks for clearing that up. Now{NEWLINE}I can finally relax. Please take{CLEAR}this little token of my thanks.

strings.zh: 本来铜镜怪圆圆小小的,{NEWLINE}没什么可怕的。{CLEAR}但是配上阿鲁夫遗迹这种神秘的氛围,{CLEAR}还真是有点吓人。
